title: Pullback maps form a morphism of long exact cohomology sequences
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $0\to G_1\xrightarrow{\alpha}G\xrightarrow{\beta}G_2\to0$ be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then:

1. $0\to u^{-1}G_1\xrightarrow{u^{-1}\alpha}u^{-1}G\xrightarrow{u^{-1}\beta}u^{-1}G_2\to0$ is a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$, $u^{-1}$ being the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].
2. For $T=X$ with the first sequence, and for $T=Y$ with the second, there are homomorphisms $\delta^q_T:H^q(T_{\Et},-_2)\to H^{q+1}(T_{\Et},-_1)$ ($q\ge0$) between the cohomology groups of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] (the connecting maps: $\mathcal H^q$ of the map $w$ of the distinguished triangle $G_1\to G\to G_2\xrightarrow{w}G_1[1]$ of [lem-sf-derived-ses-triangle], after $\RGamma(T_{\Et},-)$) such that
$$0\to H^0(G_1)\to H^0(G)\to H^0(G_2)\xrightarrow{\delta^0}H^1(G_1)\to\cdots\to H^q(G_1)\xrightarrow{H^q(\alpha)}H^q(G)\xrightarrow{H^q(\beta)}H^q(G_2)\xrightarrow{\delta^q}H^{q+1}(G_1)\to\cdots$$
is exact on $X$, and likewise on $Y$ for the pulled-back sequence.
3. The pullback maps $u^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] form a morphism between these two long exact sequences: $u^*\circ H^q(\alpha)=H^q(u^{-1}\alpha)\circ u^*$, $u^*\circ H^q(\beta)=H^q(u^{-1}\beta)\circ u^*$, and $u^*\circ\delta^q_X=\delta^q_Y\circ u^*:H^q(X_{\Et},G_2)\to H^{q+1}(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G_1)$ for every $q\ge0$.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Section 01FT (sites-cohomology-section-cohomology-sheaves: H^i(-) is a universal delta-functor) with Homology, Definition 010S (homology.tex, universal delta-functors: a map in degree 0 extends uniquely to a morphism of delta-functors); for the etale pullback, Etale Cohomology, Section 04I0 (etale-cohomology-section-functoriality). Used without mention in Etale Cohomology, Lemma 0A5C (lemma-ses-statements) and Theorem 03SC (theorem-vanishing-affine-curves)
